title: US and Denmark reach security deal after Trump’s threats to take over Greenland

Photograph: Joe Raedle/Getty Images World news US and Denmark reach security deal after Trump’s threats to take over Greenland The agreement would allow the US to expand its military presence, while Denmark and Greenland say it preserves their sovereignty and right to self-determination Robert Mackey Fri 18 Sep 2026 20.10 EDT First published on Fri 18 Sep 2026 19.02 EDT Share Prefer the Guardian on Google Donald Trump announced on Friday that the US had struck an Arctic security pact with the leaders of Denmark and Greenland, after threatening for much of his second term to annex the semi-autonomous Danish territory by force. The full scope of the deal Trump described as “very important, historic, and special” was not immediately clear. author: Robert Mackey

title: Trump and leaders of Denmark and Greenland announce plan to sign Arctic security pact next week – live
text: 18.14 EDT Trump and leaders of Denmark and Greenland announce security pact to be signed next week Donald Trump ’s threatened annexation of Greenland appears to be off the table, as the US president and the leaders of Denmark and Greenland announced on Friday that they expect to sign an Arctic security pact next week during the United Nations general assembly in New York City. Trump cast the deal as a personal triumph, claiming on social media that the agreement “gives the United States permanent control over security, and all other needs, in Greenland, completely addressing ALL of our many U.S. concerns”. “We will immediately begin the process of developing a large Military presence in the appropriate part of Greenland,” Trump added without mentioning that the US already has a presence on the island, and the right to expand bases, through Nato. Statements from Denmark’s prime minister, Mette Frederiksen , and the leader of Greenland’s government, Jens-Frederik Nielsen , posted online late Friday, emphasized that the agreement would fall far short of Trump’s stated desire for “the acquisition of Greenland by the United States”. Смотреть на Rutube Часть 1 В Старобельске не было важных военных объектов. В общежитии педагогического колледжа жили обычные студенты: учились, сдавали экзамены, участвовали в КВН, занимались спортом, дружили и строили планы на будущее.
